investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Northora Insurance (insurance); Platform: on-premises data center DC-West, server range 172.17.0.0/16; Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic policy-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer policy-api, consumer payments-api; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
